where: blaze: an idle daemon on Linux
what: An idle daemon of 60 GiB (reth built, no request) held its `iou-sqp` kernel thread at 84% of a core (top -H), and the process showed 129% while `debug inspect` said `idle: true, working: 0`; redit-11 saw the same as I/O pressure.
cost: about a core per idle daemon on a machine shared by several
cause: not found: an io_uring submission-queue poll thread that does not sleep
class: an idle process that is not idle
prevention: none built: a test that an idle daemon's CPU over ten seconds is under 1%
fix: set the SQPOLL idle time, or do not use SQPOLL for the daemon's loop
